claim: The 3^(1+12)-invariants of the Niemeier A8^3 theory (Pauli group) and of Moonshine (O_3 of the 3B normaliser) have identical graded dimensions 1, 0, 144 at weights 0, 1, 2 and differ from weight 3 (1256 vs 1016). So the two theories do not share the fixed-point subalgebra of these groups, refuting the direct route to Moonshine from 4104251. Integrality alone forces the Monster fusion of O_3(N(3B)): 3A over the 65520 orbit, 3B over the 465920 orbit.
status: exact computation; refutes the shared-fixed-subalgebra route only
